definition_zh: 比赛；竞赛；争夺；对…提出异议
definition_en: an event in which people compete, or to compete for something or argue against it
core_image: 两方站在同一块场地上，盯着同一枚奖牌
scene: 报名表贴出后，两个班级都想拿到唯一的决赛名额。Our class will contest the final against theirs.
sceneCN: 这里 contest 指「争夺」（第 2 个义项：为赢得某物而竞争）；句意是我们班将和他们班争夺决赛资格。

senses.title: A competition
senses.definition: an organized event in which people try to win by being better than others
senses.definitionCN: 人们通过胜过他人来取胜的有组织的活动
senses.example: She won the singing contest.
senses.exampleCN: 她在歌唱比赛中获胜。
senses.why: A prize means little unless someone else also wanted it.
senses.whyCN: 奖品若无人相争，也就不值什么。

senses.title: A struggle to win
senses.definition: an effort by rivals to gain the same thing
senses.definitionCN: 对手为得到同一事物而进行的较量
senses.example: Both sides contest the empty seat.
senses.exampleCN: 双方都在争夺这个空出的席位。
senses.why: Two hands reaching for one object is the oldest picture of rivalry.
senses.whyCN: 两只手伸向同一样东西，就是竞争最古老的画面。

senses.title: To call into question
senses.definition: to argue formally that a decision is wrong or unfair
senses.definitionCN: 正式指出某个决定有误或不公
senses.example: They decided to contest the fine.
senses.exampleCN: 他们决定对这笔罚款提出异议。
senses.why: To stand against a ruling is also a kind of match.
senses.whyCN: 站出来反对一项裁决，也是一场比赛。

intro.en: Contest comes from Latin contestari, to call witnesses and begin a lawsuit, built from com-, together, and testis, a witness.
intro.cn: contest 来自拉丁语 contestari，意为召集证人、提起诉讼，由 com-（一起）与 testis（证人）构成。

items.en: Testis meant a witness, the person who stands beside a case.
items.cn: testis 意为证人，即站在案子旁边的人。

items.en: Contestari meant to call witnesses and open a dispute in court.
items.cn: contestari 意为召集证人、在法庭上开始争讼。

items.en: The verb widened to mean arguing against any claim.
items.cn: 这个词义扩大为对任何主张进行争辩。

items.en: Old French conteste named a quarrel or a dispute.
items.cn: 古法语 conteste 指争吵或争执。

items.en: English contest first meant a dispute, then a trial of skill.
items.cn: 英语 contest 先指争辩，后指技艺的较量。

items.en: Today the noun usually means an organized competition.
items.cn: 今天名词通常指有组织的比赛。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin witness base test-, and the meaning group names other kinds of competition.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的证人词基 test-，近义组列出其他表示竞争的说法。

entries.definition: a person who takes part in a competition
a strong statement that something is wrong
a formal statement given as evidence
a situation in which people try to win the same thing
a sports event between two sides
a lasting competition between people

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with two sides under one test, then move to the fight for a single prize and to a ruling being challenged.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从两方同受一场检验开始，再到争夺同一个奖品，最后到对裁决提出异议。

normal.en: Con- is together and test is the test, so a contest is two sides tested together.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，test 是检验，contest 就是两方一同受检验。

normal.en: One prize and two pairs of hands: the word is already in the room.
normal.cn: 一个奖品，两双手：这个词已经在房间里了。

normal.en: A judge says a name, and one side smiles while the other argues.
normal.cn: 裁判念出一个名字，一方笑了，另一方开始争辩。

normal.en: The noun is the match, the verb is the reach for the prize.
normal.cn: 名词是那场比赛，动词是伸手去够奖品。

normal.en: A good contest leaves both sides knowing more than before.
normal.cn: 一场好的比赛，让双方都比从前知道得更多。

abstract.en: Picture two runners leaning at the same white line.
abstract.cn: 想象两名跑者在同一条白线上倾身。

abstract.en: Picture two hands closing on one medal at once.
abstract.cn: 想象两只手同时抓住同一枚奖牌。

abstract.en: Picture a raised hand in a hall, asking the ruling to be heard again.
abstract.cn: 想象会场里举起一只手，要求重新审议裁决。

examples.en: More than fifty singers entered the contest.
examples.cn: 五十多名歌手报名参加了这场比赛。

examples.en: She decided to contest the result in court.
examples.cn: 她决定在法庭上对结果提出异议。

examples.en: Two teams will contest the cup on Sunday.
examples.cn: 两支球队将在周日争夺奖杯。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 contest 记成 con（一起）加 test（检验）：两人一起接受检验，就是比赛与争夺。

root: 源自拉丁语 contestari（召集证人、提起诉讼），由 con-（一起）与 testis（证人）构成，后引申为争辩、争夺与比赛。

sensesIntro.en: From two sides tested against each other, to the reach for one prize, and at last to a ruling being challenged.
sensesIntro.cn: 从两方互相较量，到伸手够同一个奖品，最后到对裁决提出异议。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two runners leaning for the same finish line.
core.cn: 核心意象：两名跑者朝同一条终点线倾身。

branches.en: An organized event puts skill on show.
branches.cn: 有组织的活动把本领摆到台面上。

branches.en: The verb names the reach for the same object.
branches.cn: 动词点出伸向同一件东西的手。

branches.en: The oldest sense still lives in a court challenge.
branches.cn: 最古老的义项仍活在法庭上的抗辩里。

branches.en: Both senses need at least two sides.
branches.cn: 两个义项都至少需要两方。

branches.en: Fighting for something and fighting a ruling are close cousins.
branches.cn: 为某物抗争和为裁决抗争，是一对近亲。

intro.en: Contest is built on Latin com-, together, plus testis, a witness.
intro.cn: contest 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 testis（证人）构成。

latinIntro.en: The witness base test- also runs through testify, testimony and protest.
latinIntro.cn: 证人词基 test- 也贯穿 testify、testimony 与 protest。

items.exampleCN: 每位参赛者都拿到了一张卡片。
她无人竞争地赢得了席位。

items.meaning: too clear to be argued against

definition_zh: 背景；上下文；语境
definition_en: the situation or the words around something that help explain it
core_image: 一段话的左右两边，把中间那句托住
scene: 读到生词时，她先把整段话看一遍再猜意思。You can guess the word from its context.
sceneCN: 这里 context 指「上下文」（第 1 个义项：词语前后相连的文字）；句意是你可以从上下文猜出这个词的意思。

senses.title: Surrounding words
senses.definition: the words before and after a word that help fix its meaning
senses.definitionCN: 位于某词前后、帮助确定其含义的文字
senses.example: Read the whole sentence to get the context.
senses.exampleCN: 读整个句子来把握上下文。
senses.why: A word alone can point several ways, and its neighbours steady it.
senses.whyCN: 一个词单看可以有几种指向，邻居让它稳住。

senses.title: The situation around
senses.definition: the conditions and events that surround something
senses.definitionCN: 围绕某事的条件与事件
senses.example: The decision made sense in the context of that year.
senses.exampleCN: 放在那一年的背景下，这个决定是说得通的。
senses.why: Nothing happens in empty air, and the air explains it.
senses.whyCN: 没有事发生在真空里，周围的空气正好解释它。

senses.title: Setting for meaning
senses.definition: the general field in which an idea is understood
senses.definitionCN: 理解某个观念所依托的整体领域
senses.example: The word has a different force in a legal context.
senses.exampleCN: 这个词在法律语境里力度不同。
senses.why: The same sentence changes colour when the room around it changes.
senses.whyCN: 同一句话，周围的房间一换，颜色也变了。

intro.en: Context comes from Latin contexere, to weave together, built from com-, together, and texere, to weave.
intro.cn: context 来自拉丁语 contexere，意为编织在一起，由 com-（一起）与 texere（编织）构成。

items.en: Texere meant to weave cloth from separate threads.
items.cn: texere 意为把分开的线织成布。

items.en: Contexere meant to weave things into one joined whole.
items.cn: contexere 意为把事物织成一个相连的整体。

items.en: Contextus named the joining of a text as well as a fabric.
items.cn: contextus 既指织物的连接，也指文字的连缀。

items.en: French contexte named the connected body of a written work.
items.cn: 法语 contexte 指一篇文字相连的整体。

items.en: English context first meant the words around a passage.
items.cn: 英语 context 最初指一段话周围的文字。

items.en: The word has widened to mean any surrounding situation.
items.cn: 这个词后来扩大为指任何周围的处境。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin weaving base text-, and the meaning group names other ways of speaking about surroundings.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的编织词基 text-，近义组列出其他表示周边环境的说法。

entries.definition: connected with the situation around something
the written words of a book or message
a false reason given to hide the real one
the conditions that come before and around an event
the place and conditions in which something happens
a fact or condition that affects a situation

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from words woven around a line, then move to the year around a choice and to the field around an idea.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从围绕一句话织起的词开始，再到围绕一个选择的年份，最后到围绕一个观念的领域。

normal.en: Con- is together and text is woven words, so context is words woven around a word.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，text 是织成的文字，context 就是围绕一个词织起来的文字。

normal.en: Pull one sentence out of the page and it may read wrongly.
normal.cn: 把一句话从页面里抽出来，它可能就读歪了。

normal.en: The same word is warm in one letter and cold in another.
normal.cn: 同一个词在一封信里是暖的，在另一封信里是冷的。

normal.en: Ask what was happening that year before you judge the choice.
normal.cn: 判断那个选择之前，先问那一年正在发生什么。

normal.en: A frame tells you how to see the picture inside it.
normal.cn: 画框会告诉你该怎么看框里的画。

abstract.en: Picture threads running in and out of one bright strand.
abstract.cn: 想象许多线在一根亮线两侧穿进穿出。

abstract.en: Picture a lamp lighting the wall behind a small object.
abstract.cn: 想象一盏灯照亮小物件背后的墙面。

abstract.en: Picture a map with one red point and a wide pale field.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图上有一个红点和一大片浅色区域。

examples.en: You can often guess a new word from its context.
examples.cn: 你常常能从上下文猜出一个新词的意思。

examples.en: The remark was harmless in context.
examples.cn: 这句话放在上下文里并无恶意。

examples.en: We need to see the plan in its historical context.
examples.cn: 我们需要把这项计划放回历史背景中看。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 context 记成 con（一起）加 text（文字）：一起摆在旁边的文字，就是上下文。

root: 源自拉丁语 contexere（编织在一起），由 con-（一起）与 texere（编织）构成，本指文字相连，后指上下文与背景。

sensesIntro.en: From words woven around a line, to the year around a choice, and at last to the whole field around an idea.
sensesIntro.cn: 从围绕一句话织起的文字，到围绕一个选择的年份，最后到围绕一个观念的整个领域。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: threads weaving in and out of one bright strand.
core.cn: 核心意象：许多线在一根亮线两侧穿进穿出。

branches.en: Neighbouring words decide how a word is taken.
branches.cn: 相邻的词决定一个词该怎么理解。

branches.en: The year around a choice explains the choice.
branches.cn: 选择周围的年月解释了那个选择。

branches.en: A whole field of study gives a word its weight.
branches.cn: 整个研究领域给了一个词分量。

branches.en: Both senses answer the question of what surrounds a thing.
branches.cn: 两个义项都在回答某物被什么包围。

branches.en: A situation and a field both hold an idea in place.
branches.cn: 处境和领域都把某个观念固定住。

intro.en: Context is built on Latin com-, together, plus texere, to weave.
intro.cn: context 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 texere（编织）构成。

latinIntro.en: The weaving base text- also appears in textile, texture and pretext.
latinIntro.cn: 编织词基 text- 也出现在 textile、texture 与 pretext 中。

items.meaningCN: 织在一段话周围的文字
items.example: The line makes sense in context.
items.exampleCN: 这句话放在上下文里说得通。
语境线索对读者有帮助。

items.meaning: in a way tied to the situation
items.exampleCN: 这个短语从语境看很清楚。

items.meaning: to place something in its setting
items.exampleCN: 作者把这封信放回了背景中。

items.meaning: written words as a woven whole
items.example: The text is short but dense.

items.meaning: the feel of a woven surface
items.example: The cloth has a rough texture.

items.meaning: a woven excuse put in front
items.example: He left on a weak pretext.
items.exampleCN: 他找了个勉强的借口离开。

definition_zh: 大洲；大陆
definition_en: one of the large separate areas of land on earth, or the main land apart from its islands
core_image: 一块被海水围住的巨大陆地，边缘被浪画出线
scene: 地图摊开，老师指着最大的一片陆地说出名字。Africa is the second largest continent.
sceneCN: 这里 continent 指「大洲」（第 1 个义项：地球上彼此分开的巨大陆地区域）；句意是非洲是面积第二大的洲。

senses.title: A great landmass
senses.definition: one of the large areas of land that the earth is divided into
senses.definitionCN: 地球上被划分出来的几块巨大陆地区域之一
senses.example: Asia is the largest continent.
senses.exampleCN: 亚洲是最大的洲。
senses.why: The sea draws the border that makes a continent one thing.
senses.whyCN: 海画出的边界，让一片陆地成为一个整体。

senses.title: The mainland
senses.definition: the main continuous land, as opposed to nearby islands
senses.definitionCN: 与附近岛屿相对的主要连片陆地
senses.example: The ferry links the island to the continent.
senses.exampleCN: 渡船把小岛与大陆连起来。
senses.why: An island sees the mainland as one big neighbour.
senses.whyCN: 岛屿把大陆看成一个巨大的邻居。

intro.en: Continent comes from Latin continens, continuous or holding together, from continere, to hold together, built from com-, together, and tenere, to hold.
intro.cn: continent 来自拉丁语 continens（连绵不断、连在一起），源于 continere（保持在一起），由 com-（一起）与 tenere（握住）构成。

items.en: Tenere meant to hold or keep in the hand.
items.cn: tenere 意为握住或保持在手中。

items.en: Continere meant to hold things together as one.
items.cn: continere 意为把事物保持为一个整体。

items.en: Continens described land that runs on without a break.
items.cn: continens 形容连绵不断、没有中断的陆地。

items.en: The noun terra continens, the continuous land, was shortened in use.
items.cn: 短语 terra continens（连成一片的陆地）在使用中被省略。

items.en: English continent named the great landmasses of the globe.
items.cn: 英语 continent 指地球上的几块巨大陆地。

items.en: It also means the mainland seen from an island.
items.cn: 它也表示从岛屿看去的大陆。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin holding base tin-, and the meaning group names other words for large pieces of land.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的握持词基 tin-，近义组列出其他表示大片陆地的词。

entries.definition: belonging to a continent
to keep going without stopping
to have something inside
the main land of a country, not its islands
a very large area of land
a large area of a country or the world

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from land held together by the sea, then move to the mainland seen from an island.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从被海围住、连成一片的陆地开始，再到从岛上望见的大陆。

normal.en: Con- is together and tin is hold, so a continent is land held together.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，tin 是握住，continent 就是被握在一起的一片陆地。

normal.en: Pour blue water around a brown shape and you have made the word.
normal.cn: 在褐色地块周围倒上一圈蓝色，你就造出了这个词。

normal.en: A continent is big enough that you forget its edges.
normal.cn: 大陆大到你会忘记它的边缘。

normal.en: From a small island, the mainland is simply the continent.
normal.cn: 从小岛望去，本土就是大陆。

normal.en: Seven great pieces, one round globe.
normal.cn: 七块巨大的陆地，一个圆圆的地球。

abstract.en: Picture a brown shape with a thin white line of surf.
abstract.cn: 想象一块褐色陆地，边上镶着一线白浪。

abstract.en: Picture a ferry crossing a grey strait toward a wide shore.
abstract.cn: 想象一艘渡船穿过灰色海峡，驶向宽阔的海岸。

abstract.en: Picture a globe turned slowly until one mass fills the view.
abstract.cn: 想象地球缓缓转动，直到一整块陆地占满视野。

examples.en: The continent is rich in minerals.
examples.cn: 这片大陆矿产丰富。

examples.en: Few birds cross the whole continent.
examples.cn: 很少有鸟飞越整片大陆。

examples.en: Storms moved slowly across the continent.
examples.cn: 风暴缓缓扫过大陆。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 continent 记成 con（一起）加 tin（握住）：一大片土地被海围住、始终连在一起，就是大陆。

root: 源自拉丁语 continens（连绵不断的），来自 continere（保持在一起），由 con-（一起）与 tenere（握住）构成。

sensesIntro.en: From one great land held together by the sea, to the mainland that an island looks toward.
sensesIntro.cn: 从被海围住的巨大陆块，到岛屿所遥望的大陆。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a brown landmass ringed by one thin line of surf.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块褐色陆地，被一线白浪围住。

branches.en: The largest division of land gets its own name.
branches.cn: 最大的一级陆地区域有了自己的名字。

branches.en: An island measures itself against the mainland.
branches.cn: 岛屿以大陆为参照来衡量自己。

branches.en: Both senses rest on land that holds together.
branches.cn: 两个义项都立足于连成一片的陆地。

branches.en: A continent is defined by the water around it.
branches.cn: 大洲由它周围的水来界定。

branches.en: The mainland is a continent seen from a smaller shore.
branches.cn: 大陆是从较小海岸望去的大洲。

intro.en: Continent is built on Latin com-, together, plus tenere, to hold.
intro.cn: continent 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 tenere（握住）构成。

latinIntro.en: The holding base ten- also appears in contain, retain and tenant.
latinIntro.cn: 握持词基 ten- 也出现在 contain、retain 与 tenant 中。

items.meaning: land held together as one mass
items.example: They crossed the continent by rail.

items.exampleCN: 洲际航班要飞好几个小时。

items.meaning: a large land area slightly smaller than a continent
items.meaningCN: 比大洲略小的大片陆地
items.example: The river feeds a whole subcontinent.
items.exampleCN: 这条河养活了整个次大陆。

items.meaning: to keep holding on without a break
to keep something rather than lose it
a person who holds a rented place

definition_zh: 频繁反复的；不断的；连续的
definition_en: happening again and again, often over a long period
core_image: 门铃刚停又响，一次接着一次
scene: 隔壁装修声隔几分钟就响一阵，让人没法专心。The continual noise made it hard to work.
sceneCN: 这里 continual 指「频繁反复的」（第 1 个义项：反复发生、其间有短暂停顿）；句意是不断反复的噪音让人难以工作。

pos.zh: 频繁反复的；不断的；连续的

senses.title: Again and again
senses.definition: repeated many times, with short breaks between the times
senses.definitionCN: 多次重复，各次之间只有短暂停顿
senses.example: His continual questions tired the teacher.
senses.exampleCN: 他没完没了地提问，让老师很累。
senses.why: A quiet that keeps being broken feels worse than one long noise.
senses.whyCN: 一次次被打断的安静，比一整片噪音更难受。

senses.title: Going on without pause
senses.definition: lasting over a long period and seeming never to stop
senses.definitionCN: 长时间持续，仿佛永不停止
senses.example: The continual flow of visitors never slowed.
senses.exampleCN: 来访的人流一直没有慢下来。
senses.why: When nothing interrupts, the line simply keeps going.
senses.whyCN: 没有东西打断时，线就一直往前走。

intro.en: Continual comes from Latin continuus, unbroken, from continere, to hold together, with the adjective ending -al added.
intro.cn: continual 来自拉丁语 continuus（相连不断的），源于 continere（保持在一起），后面加上形容词词尾 -al。

items.en: Continere meant to hold things together without a gap.
items.cn: continere 意为把事物无空隙地保持在一起。

items.en: Continuus described what hangs together in an unbroken line.
items.cn: continuus 形容连成一条不断之线的事物。

items.en: Continuare meant to make something go on without stopping.
items.cn: continuare 意为使某事不停地进行下去。

items.en: French continua kept the sense of lasting and repeated.
items.cn: 法语 continua 保留了持续与反复的含义。

items.en: English continual named what keeps coming back.
items.cn: 英语 continual 指一再回来的事物。

items.en: It now often hints at weariness with the repetition.
items.cn: 如今它常暗示对反复的厌烦。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the close continuous family, and the meaning group names other words for what keeps happening.
note.cn: 形近组收的是同一词族里容易混用的几个词，近义组列出其他表示反复发生的词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a thing that keeps returning, then turn to a flow that seems never to stop.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一再回来的事物开始，再转到似乎永不停止的流动。

normal.en: Continual is continue plus -al: the same act come back again.
normal.cn: continual 就是 continue 加 -al：同一个动作又回来了。

normal.en: Think of a doorbell that rings, stops, and rings once more.
normal.cn: 想一想门铃响了、停了、又响一次。

normal.en: Continual has gaps, while continuous has none.
normal.cn: continual 有间隙，continuous 没有。

normal.en: The word often carries a sigh in the next sentence.
normal.cn: 这个词后面常常跟着一声叹气。

normal.en: A small tap, repeated, can wear a stone.
normal.cn: 一次次轻敲，也能磨损石头。

abstract.en: Picture a line made of short dashes, not one long stroke.
abstract.cn: 想象一条由短横组成的线，而不是一笔长划。

abstract.en: Picture a kettle that boils, stops, and boils again.
abstract.cn: 想象一只水壶烧开、停下、又烧开。

abstract.en: Picture footsteps passing the door at short intervals.
abstract.cn: 想象脚步声隔一小会儿就经过门口。

examples.en: The continual noise from the road kept her awake.
examples.cn: 路上不断传来的噪音让她睡不着。

examples.en: He was tired of their continual arguments.
examples.cn: 他对他们没完没了的争吵感到厌倦。

examples.en: The garden needs continual care in summer.
examples.cn: 夏天花园需要不断照料。

sensesIntro.en: From something that keeps coming back, to a flow that looks as if it will never stop.

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a line drawn in short dashes that keep repeating.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条由不断重复的短横画成的线。

branches.en: The repeated event is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 反复发生的事件是日常最常用的义项。

branches.en: A long unbroken flow stretches the same word.
branches.cn: 长时间的不断流动把同一个词拉长了。

branches.en: Both senses share the idea of coming back.
branches.cn: 两个义项共享回来的意思。

branches.en: Small gaps do not save the listener from the noise.
branches.cn: 小小的间隙并不能让听者躲开噪音。

branches.en: Endless repetition begins to feel like one sound.
branches.cn: 无止境的重复开始听起来像一种声音。

definition_zh: 继续；持续；延伸
definition_en: to keep doing something after a pause, to go on without stopping, or to stretch further
core_image: 一条路穿过田野，一直伸到看不见的地方
scene: 雨停了一会儿又下起来，队伍仍往前走。They decided to continue the march after a short rest.
sceneCN: 这里 continue 指「继续」（第 1 个义项：停顿之后接着做同一件事）；句意是他们决定稍作休息后继续行军。

senses.title: Keep doing
senses.definition: to go on with an activity after a short pause
senses.definitionCN: 短暂停顿之后接着做同一件事
senses.example: She continued her story after a sip of tea.
senses.exampleCN: 她喝了口茶，接着讲她的故事。
senses.why: A pause is not an ending, for the thread can be picked up again.
senses.whyCN: 停顿不是结束，线还能再捡起来。

senses.title: Go on without stopping
senses.definition: to last or keep happening without a break
senses.definitionCN: 不间断地延续或发生
senses.example: The rain continued all night.
senses.exampleCN: 雨下了一整夜。
senses.why: Some things have no clear edge where they might stop.
senses.whyCN: 有些事物没有明显的边可以让它停下。

senses.title: Stretch onward
senses.definition: to extend further in space
senses.definitionCN: 在空间上向前延伸
senses.example: The path continues beyond the hill.
senses.exampleCN: 小路越过山丘继续延伸。
senses.why: A line drawn on a map asks to be followed.
senses.whyCN: 地图上画出的线，总在请人跟着走。

intro.en: Continue comes from Latin continuare, to join together and carry on, from continuus, unbroken, and before that from continere, to hold together.
intro.cn: continue 来自拉丁语 continuare（连接起来、接着进行），源于 continuus（不间断的），更早出自 continere（保持在一起）。

items.en: Continere meant to hold things together in one piece.
items.cn: continere 意为把事物保持成一个整体。

items.en: Continuus meant hanging together with no break.
items.cn: continuus 意为连在一起而没有断开。

items.en: Continuare meant to make a thing go on further.
items.cn: continuare 意为使某事继续向前。

items.en: French continuer meant to carry on a begun action.
items.cn: 法语 continuer 意为把已开始的动作接着做下去。

items.en: English continue kept both the time and the space senses.
items.cn: 英语 continue 同时保留时间与空间两层意思。

items.en: It now covers pausing, lasting and stretching onward.
items.cn: 如今它涵盖停顿后继续、持续与向前延伸。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the nearest members of the continue family, and the meaning group names other verbs for going on.
note.cn: 形近组收的是 continue 词族里最容易混的几个词，近义组列出其他表示进行下去的动词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a thread taken up again, then move to rain that will not stop and a road that keeps going.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从重新捡起的线开始，再到停不下来的雨，最后到一直往前伸展的路。

normal.en: Con- is together and tin is hold, so continue is holding on to the same thread.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，tin 是握住，continue 就是一直握着同一条线。

normal.en: Put down the cup, pick up the sentence: that is the verb.
normal.cn: 放下杯子，重新拿起那句话：这就是这个动词。

normal.en: Rain does not need permission to keep falling.
normal.cn: 雨要继续下，并不需要谁的允许。

normal.en: A path that keeps going is doing the same word in space.
normal.cn: 一条继续向前的小路，是在空间里做同一个词。

normal.en: Stop, breathe, then continue.
normal.cn: 停下，呼吸，然后继续。

abstract.en: Picture a dropped thread lifted from the floor.
abstract.cn: 想象一根掉在地上的线被重新捡起。

abstract.en: Picture a page turned, with the sentence running on.
abstract.cn: 想象翻过一页，句子仍在往下走。

abstract.en: Picture a road that narrows but never ends.
abstract.cn: 想象一条越来越窄却始终不结束的路。

examples.en: The meeting will continue after lunch.
examples.cn: 会议将在午饭后继续。

examples.en: The noise continued into the night.
examples.cn: 噪音一直持续到夜里。

examples.en: The valley continues for many miles.
examples.cn: 这条山谷延伸了许多英里。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 continue 记成 con（一起）加 tin（握住）：把线一直握在手里不放，就是继续。

root: 源自拉丁语 continuare（连接起来、接着进行），来自 continuus（不间断的）与 continere（保持在一起），指继续、持续与延伸。

sensesIntro.en: From picking up an action after a pause, to lasting without a break, and at last to stretching through space.
sensesIntro.cn: 从停顿后重新接上动作，到不间断地持续，最后到在空间中向前延伸。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thread held in one hand that never leaves it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手握着线，始终没有松开。

branches.en: The first sense picks an action back up.
branches.cn: 第一个义项把动作重新捡起来。

branches.en: The second sense lets time run without a break.
branches.cn: 第二个义项让时间不间断地流。

branches.en: The third sense lays the same idea on the ground.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把同一个意思铺到地面上。

branches.en: Both senses share the refusal to end.
branches.cn: 两个义项都共享不肯结束这一点。

branches.en: What lasts in time can also reach across space.
branches.cn: 在时间里延续的东西，也能横跨空间。

intro.cn: continue 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 tenere（握住）构成。

latinIntro.cn: 握持词基 tin- 也贯穿 continuous、continuity 与 contain。

definition_en: happening or existing without any break or gap
core_image: 一笔画到底的直线，中间没有断口
scene: 印刷机一开就停不下来，纸带一直往外送。The press produced a continuous sheet of paper.
sceneCN: 这里 continuous 指「不间断的」（第 1 个义项：中间没有中断）；句意是印刷机送出一整条没有断口的纸。

pos.zh: 连续的；不间断的；连绵的

senses.title: Without a break
senses.definition: going on with no pause or gap in time
senses.definitionCN: 在时间上进行中没有任何停顿或缺口
senses.example: A continuous line runs along the top of the page.
senses.exampleCN: 一条不断的线横贯页面顶端。
senses.why: The eye trusts a line that never lifts from the paper.
senses.whyCN: 眼睛信任一条始终没离开纸面的线。

senses.title: Unbroken in space
senses.definition: covering an area from end to end without gaps
senses.definitionCN: 在空间上从头到尾连成一片没有空隙
senses.example: A continuous wall surrounds the old town.
senses.exampleCN: 一道连绵的墙围着老城。
senses.why: No gate and no crack means the wall reads as one thing.
senses.whyCN: 没有门也没有裂缝，墙就读成一个整体。

senses.title: Steady in supply
senses.definition: provided at every moment over a period of time
senses.definitionCN: 在一段时间内每一刻都得到供应
senses.example: The plant needs a continuous supply of cool air.
senses.exampleCN: 这座工厂需要持续的冷气供应。
senses.why: Some processes cannot wait for the next delivery.
senses.whyCN: 有些过程等不到下一批货。

intro.en: Continuous comes from Latin continuus, hanging together without a break, from continere, to hold together.
intro.cn: continuous 来自拉丁语 continuus（连在一起、不断开），源于 continere（保持在一起）。

items.en: Continere meant to keep parts in one unbroken whole.
items.cn: continere 意为把各部分保持在一个不断开的整体里。

items.en: Continuus described a line or period with no gap.
items.cn: continuus 形容没有缺口的线或时段。

items.en: The suffix -ous marked a quality in adjectives.
items.cn: 后缀 -ous 在形容词里表示某种性质。

items.en: French continu carried the same unbroken sense.
items.cn: 法语 continu 带有同样的不断义。

items.en: English continuous was used for time, space and motion.
items.cn: 英语 continuous 用于时间、空间与运动。

items.en: It is now carefully kept apart from continual.
items.cn: 如今它被小心地与 continual 区分开。

note.en: The look-alike group sets continuous against its closest relatives, and the meaning group names other words for what does not break.
note.cn: 形近组把 continuous 与最亲近的几个词放在一起，近义组列出其他表示不断开的词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a line that never lifts, then move to a wall without a gate and a supply that never waits.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从始终不抬起的线开始，再到没有门的墙，最后到等不得的供应。

normal.en: Continuous means no gap, while continual means many gaps.
normal.cn: continuous 是没有缺口，continual 是许多缺口。

normal.en: Draw one stroke across the page and do not lift the pen.
normal.cn: 在纸上一笔画过去，不要抬笔。

normal.en: A wall with no gate is continuous, and so is a hum with no pause.
normal.cn: 没有门的墙是不间断的，没有停顿的嗡嗡声也是。

normal.en: Think of a tap that never closes for an hour.
normal.cn: 想一想一只一小时都没关的水龙头。

normal.en: If you can point to a break, the word is not this one.
normal.cn: 只要你能指出一处中断，这个词就不适用。

abstract.en: Picture a single white stroke on a dark page.
abstract.cn: 想象深色纸面上只有一笔白线。

abstract.en: Picture a ribbon pulled tight with no knot.
abstract.cn: 想象一条拉紧、没有打结的丝带。

abstract.en: Picture a river that never shows a dry stone.
abstract.cn: 想象一条从不露出干石的河。

examples.en: The machine needs a continuous supply of water.
examples.cn: 这台机器需要持续供水。

examples.en: A continuous line of cars filled the road.
examples.cn: 一长串不断的车占满了路。

examples.en: The baby slept in a continuous stretch.
examples.cn: 婴儿一口气睡了很久没有醒。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 continuous 记成 continue（继续）加 ous（形容词尾）：一路继下去、中间不断，就是连续的。

sensesIntro.en: From time with no pause, to space with no gap, and at last to a supply that never stops arriving.
sensesIntro.cn: 从没有停顿的时间，到没有空隙的空间，最后到从不断供的供应。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one white stroke drawn without lifting the pen.
core.cn: 核心意象：一笔画成、始终没有抬笔的白线。

branches.en: Time runs on without a pause in the first sense.
branches.cn: 第一个义项里时间毫无停顿地流。

branches.en: Space joins end to end in the second sense.
branches.cn: 第二个义项里空间首尾相接。

branches.en: A steady supply keeps the process alive.
branches.cn: 稳定的供应让过程得以维持。

branches.en: Both senses refuse to show a break.
branches.cn: 两个义项都不肯露出一处断口。

branches.en: A wall without a gate and a tap without a stop share one shape.
branches.cn: 没有门的墙与不停的水龙头共用一个形状。

items.exampleCN: 接连的故障毁了这次旅行。

items.example: The series is a continuation of his early work.

definition_zh: 连续不断地；不停地；接连地
definition_en: in a way that goes on without any pause or gap
core_image: 水龙头一直滴着水，杯子慢慢被填满
scene: 实验记录上，温度曲线没有一处断点。The sensor recorded the temperature continuously for a week.

pos.zh: 连续不断地；不停地；接连地

senses.title: Without pause
senses.definition: with no break in time at all
senses.definitionCN: 在时间上完全没有中断
senses.example: The pump runs continuously.
senses.exampleCN: 泵不停地运转。
senses.why: A watch that never stops is the simplest proof of the word.
senses.whyCN: 一只从不停走的表，就是这个义项最简单的证明。

senses.title: At every moment
senses.definition: at each moment, without any exception
senses.definitionCN: 每一刻都如此，没有任何例外
senses.example: She was continuously aware of the clock.
senses.exampleCN: 她始终留意着那只钟。
senses.why: Attention that never blinks is rare and heavy.

senses.title: In an unbroken series

senses.why: A queue with no empty spot looks like one long body.

intro.en: Continuously is the adverb built from continuous, which comes from Latin continuus, unbroken, and before that from continere, to hold together.
intro.cn: continuously 是由 continuous 加副词词尾构成的副词，continuous 来自拉丁语 continuus（不断开的），更早出自 continere（保持在一起）。

items.en: Continere meant to hold parts together without a gap.
items.cn: continere 意为把各部分无空隙地保持在一起。

items.en: Continuus described anything that runs on unbroken.
items.cn: continuus 形容任何不断延续的事物。

items.en: The adverb ending -e marked how an action was done.
items.cn: 拉丁语的副词词尾 -e 表示动作进行的方式。

items.en: English continuous gained the adverb form continuously.
items.cn: 英语 continuous 衍生出副词形式 continuously。

items.en: The adverb was used for motion, time and supply.
items.cn: 这个副词被用于运动、时间与供应。

items.en: It now often appears in technical and scientific writing.
items.cn: 如今它常出现在技术与科学写作中。

note.en: The look-alike group places the adverb beside its adjective and verb, and the meaning group names other adverbs of unbroken action.
note.cn: 形近组把这个副词与它的形容词、动词放在一起，近义组列出其他表示不间断的副词。

normal.en: No gap, no pause, no empty place.

abstract.en: Picture a row of beads touching edge to edge.

abstract.en: Picture a printer laying one unbroken band of ink.

examples.en: The engine has run continuously since morning.

senses.title: A written agreement

senses.title: To catch an illness

senses.title: Two claims at odds

senses.definitionCN: 两句话不能同时为真的状态

senses.exampleCN: 两份报告之间存在矛盾。

senses.title: A self-defeating phrase

intro.en: Contribute comes from Latin contribuere, to bring together as a share, built from com-, together, and tribuere, to allot.
intro.cn: contribute 来自拉丁语 contribuere（把份额凑到一起），由 com-（一起）与 tribuere（分配）构成。

normal.cn: 控制火势靠把它弄小，而不是弄大。

normal.en: The switch is where the whole machine listens.
normal.cn: 开关就是整台机器听话的地方。

abstract.en: Picture one hand closing gently on a rein.

abstract.en: Picture a flame shrinking under a metal cup.

abstract.en: Picture a row of dials under a single thumb.
abstract.cn: 想象一排旋钮都在一根拇指之下。

examples.en: The driver lost control of the truck.

sensesIntro.en: From the power to direct, to keeping a danger small, and at last to the switch where the machine listens.

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one hand closing on a rein.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手合拢在缰绳上。

branches.en: Power over motion is the central sense.
branches.cn: 对运动的主导是核心义项。

branches.en: Power also means keeping a danger small.

branches.en: The switch is power made into an object.

branches.en: Directing and limiting are two sides of one hand.

branches.en: A dial can hold a process inside safe limits.

items.meaningCN: 被限制在设定范围内的

definition_zh: 有争议的；引起争论的；未有定论的
definition_en: causing strong public disagreement, or still open to doubt
core_image: 一个话题被两群人从两边同时拉住
scene: 新规定一贴出，楼下立刻分成两拨人争论。The new rule proved highly controversial.
sceneCN: 这里 controversial 指「有争议的」（第 1 个义项：让众人激烈争论的）；句意是新规定被证明极具争议。

pos.zh: 有争议的；引起争论的；未有定论的

senses.title: Causing strong argument
senses.definition: making people argue strongly about it
senses.definitionCN: 让众人为此激烈争论的
senses.example: The plan is controversial among farmers.
senses.exampleCN: 这个方案在农民中很有争议。
senses.why: A question with two loud answers will not sit still.
senses.whyCN: 一个问题若有两个响亮的答案，就安静不下来。

senses.title: Debated in public
senses.definition: publicly questioned by many people over time
senses.definitionCN: 长时间被许多人在公共场合质疑的
senses.example: His record remains controversial today.
senses.exampleCN: 他的履历至今仍引起争论。
senses.why: A public story can be told two ways for a long time.
senses.whyCN: 一个公开的故事，能被两种讲法讲很久。

senses.title: Not settled
senses.definition: still open to doubt because no side has won
senses.definitionCN: 因为没有任何一方胜出而仍可怀疑
senses.example: Whether the drug helps is still controversial.
senses.exampleCN: 这种药是否有效仍无定论。
senses.why: Evidence that points both ways keeps a verdict waiting.
senses.whyCN: 两向都指的证词，让判决迟迟不来。

intro.en: Controversial comes from Latin controversia, a dispute, from controversus, turned in the opposite direction, built on contra-, against, and vertere, to turn.
intro.cn: controversial 来自拉丁语 controversia（争执），源于 controversus（转向反面），由 contra-（反对）与 vertere（转）构成。

items.en: Vertere meant to turn or turn around.
items.cn: vertere 意为转动或转身。

items.en: Controversus meant turned against or facing the other way.
items.cn: controversus 意为转过来相对或朝着反面。

items.en: Controversia named a dispute between turned sides.
items.cn: controversia 指两方相对而起的争执。

items.en: French controverse kept the sense of a public quarrel.
items.cn: 法语 controverse 保留了公开争吵之义。

items.en: English controversy was used for religious debate.
items.cn: 英语 controversy 曾用于宗教辩论。

items.en: The adjective now covers any widely disputed matter.
items.cn: 形容词如今涵盖任何广受争议的事情。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin turning base vers-, and the meaning group names other words for what is argued over.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的转动词基 vers-，近义组列出其他表示被争辩之事的词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a question that splits a crowd, then move to a long public story and a verdict that never comes.

normal.en: Controversial is the adjective of controversy: it makes a quarrel.
normal.cn: controversial 是 controversy 的形容词：它制造争吵。

normal.en: Contra- is against and vers is turn, so the word is about sides turning against each other.

normal.en: A controversial rule is one that no one can quietly obey.
normal.cn: 有争议的规定，是没人能安静照做的那种规定。

normal.en: A figure can stay controversial for a hundred years.
normal.cn: 一个人物可以争议上百年。

normal.en: Two loud answers, no settled question.
normal.cn: 两个响亮的答案，一个没有定下来的问题。

abstract.en: Picture two crowds pulling one rope from both ends.
abstract.cn: 想象两群人在绳子两端对拉。

abstract.en: Picture a headline that divides a breakfast table.
abstract.cn: 想象一条把早餐桌分成两半的新闻标题。

abstract.en: Picture a scale stuck level, with neither side down.
abstract.cn: 想象一架卡在水平位置的天平，两边都不落下。

examples.en: The choice of site was highly controversial.
examples.cn: 选址极具争议。

examples.en: He wrote a controversial book about the war.
examples.cn: 他写了一本关于这场战争的有争议的书。

examples.en: The method remains controversial among doctors.
examples.cn: 这种方法在医生中仍有争议。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 controversial 记成 contro（相对）加 vers（转）加 ial：两方转过身来对着彼此争，就是有争议的。

root: 源自拉丁语 controversus（转向反面），由 contra-（反对）与 vertere（转）构成，经 controversia（争执）加 -al 成为形容词。

sensesIntro.en: From a question that splits a crowd, to a long public story, and at last to a verdict that has not arrived.
sensesIntro.cn: 从把人分成两半的问题，到讲得很久的公开故事，最后到还没有到来的判决。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two crowds pulling one rope from opposite ends.
core.cn: 核心意象：两群人在绳子两端对拉。

branches.en: The first sense is simply the power to cause argument.
branches.cn: 第一个义项就是引起争吵的力量。

branches.en: The second sense keeps the argument in public view.
branches.cn: 第二个义项让争论一直待在公众视野里。

branches.en: The third sense says the question is still open.
branches.cn: 第三个义项说这个问题仍然敞着。

branches.en: Argument that lasts becomes public controversy.
branches.cn: 持续下去的争吵会变成公开争议。

branches.en: Where the public keeps arguing, no verdict settles.
branches.cn: 公众一直争的地方，判决也定不下来。

intro.en: Controversial is built on Latin contra-, against, plus vertere, to turn.
intro.cn: controversial 由拉丁语 contra-（反对）与 vertere（转）构成。

latinIntro.cn: 转动词基 vers- 也出现在 convert、divert 与 reverse 中。

items.meaning: a turning of sides against sides
in a way that starts argument

items.example: No one could controvert the facts.

items.meaning: a person who argues in public
to turn something into another form
items.meaningCN: 把某物转成另一种形式

definition_zh: 争论；争议；论战
definition_en: a long public argument about something that many people disagree on
core_image: 报纸上两封对开的来信，字句彼此顶撞
scene: 一份报告公布后，评论区吵了好几周。The report caused a long controversy.
sceneCN: 这里 controversy 指「争议」（第 1 个义项：许多人之间持续很久的公开争论）；句意是这份报告引发了长时间的争议。

senses.title: A public quarrel
senses.definition: a long public argument among many people
senses.definitionCN: 许多人之间持续很久的公开争论
senses.example: The new road caused years of controversy.
senses.exampleCN: 这条新路引起了多年的争议。
senses.why: A crowd that cannot agree keeps the noise going.
senses.whyCN: 一群人若不能达成一致，声音就不会停。

senses.title: A dispute in words
senses.definition: a battle fought with statements rather than force
senses.definitionCN: 用言论而不是武力进行的交锋
senses.example: The two journals carried on a bitter controversy.
senses.exampleCN: 两家期刊打了一场激烈的论战。
senses.why: Ink can be as loud as a shout in a square.
senses.whyCN: 纸上的墨，也能像广场上的喊声一样响。

senses.title: A doubtful matter
senses.definition: a particular matter about which people hold opposite views
senses.definitionCN: 人们持相反看法的某一具体事件
senses.example: The choice of judge became a controversy of its own.
senses.exampleCN: 法官的人选本身成了一件有争议的事。
senses.why: Even the referee can become the match.
senses.whyCN: 连裁判也能变成比赛本身。

intro.en: Controversy comes from Latin controversia, a dispute, from controversus, turned against, built on contra-, against, and vertere, to turn.

items.en: Vertere meant to turn one's body or a thing.

items.en: Controversus meant turned face to face in opposition.

items.en: Controversia named the dispute that such turning produced.

items.en: It now covers disputes in law, science and daily life.
items.cn: 如今它涵盖法律、科学与日常生活中的争议。

normal.en: Contra- is against and vers is turn, so a controversy is sides turned against each other.

normal.en: Old books fought their wars with ink.
normal.cn: 古书用墨打它们的仗。

normal.en: A controversy lasts because no side will sit down.
normal.cn: 争议之所以持久，是因为没有一方肯坐下。

normal.en: Even the choice of judge can become the fight.
normal.cn: 连选谁当裁判都能变成那场争斗。

normal.en: Two views, one public room, no exit.
normal.cn: 两种看法，一间公共的屋子，没有出口。

abstract.en: Picture two letters printed side by side, facing each other.
abstract.cn: 想象两封并排印出的信，彼此面对。

abstract.en: Picture a courtroom where each side holds a book.
abstract.cn: 想象一间法庭，两方各抱一本书。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd splitting around one small table.
abstract.cn: 想象人群围绕一张小桌分成两边。

examples.en: The building plan caused great controversy.
examples.cn: 这项建筑计划引起了很大争议。

examples.en: He stayed at the centre of the controversy.
examples.cn: 他一直处在争议的中心。

examples.en: The controversy over the results lasted for months.

branches.en: A crowd and a press can keep one argument alive.

senses.title: Ease of use

senses.definitionCN: 与人的需要相合而省力的性质
senses.example: The app was chosen for its convenience.
senses.exampleCN: 选这个应用是因为它方便。

senses.title: A helpful facility

senses.title: A suitable moment

items.en: Convenire meant to come together in one place.

items.en: Convenientia named the fitting together of two things.
items.cn: convenientia 指两件事彼此相合。

items.en: French convenance kept the sense of fitting well.
items.cn: 法语 convenance 保留了恰好相合之义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin coming base ven-, and the meaning group names other words for ease and comfort.

latinIntro.en: The coming base ven- also appears in convene, convention and event.
latinIntro.cn: 来词基 ven- 也出现在 convene、convention 与 event 中。

items.meaning: a state of things fitting together
items.example: The shop is open for convenience.
items.exampleCN: 这家店为方便顾客而开着。

items.meaning: in a fitting or easy way
items.exampleCN: 公交站就在附近很方便。
我们为这带来的不便致歉。

items.meaning: to call people to come together
a coming together or an agreed habit
items.meaningCN: 聚到一起或共同接受的惯例

definition_zh: 方便的；近便的；合适的
definition_en: easy to use, reach or fit into a plan
core_image: 地铁口正对着小区大门
scene: 出门两分钟就到车站，买菜也不用过马路。The flat is convenient for the station.
sceneCN: 这里 convenient 指「近便的」（第 1 个义项：距离近或程序简单而省力）；句意是这套公寓去车站很方便。

senses.title: Easy to reach
senses.definition: near enough or simple enough to save effort
senses.definitionCN: 距离够近或程序够简单而省力
senses.example: The hotel is convenient for the airport.
senses.exampleCN: 这家酒店去机场很方便。
senses.why: Nearness is measured in effort, not in metres.
senses.whyCN: 远近是按力气算的，不是按米算的。

senses.title: Fitting the plan
senses.definition: arranged at a time or in a way that suits someone
senses.definitionCN: 在时间或方式上适合某人的
senses.example: Let us meet at a convenient hour.
senses.exampleCN: 我们挑个合适的时间见面吧。
senses.why: A good hour is one nobody has to fight the clock for.
senses.whyCN: 好的时间，是没人需要和钟表较劲的时间。

senses.title: Handy for use
senses.definition: designed to be simple to operate
senses.definitionCN: 设计得容易操作
senses.example: The handle is at a convenient height.
senses.exampleCN: 把手的高度正合适使用。
senses.why: A tool should meet the hand halfway.
senses.whyCN: 工具应当朝手走一半路。

intro.en: Convenient comes from Latin convenire, to come together or fit, built on com-, together, and venire, to come.
intro.cn: convenient 来自拉丁语 convenire（走到一起、相合），由 com-（一起）与 venire（来）构成。

items.en: Venire meant to come near or arrive.
items.cn: venire 意为靠近或到达。

items.en: Convenire meant to meet and to fit together.
items.cn: convenire 意为相遇，也指彼此相合。

items.en: The participle conveniens described what fits well.
items.cn: 分词 conveniens 形容恰好相合的事物。

items.en: French convenant kept the sense of suitable.
items.cn: 法语 convenant 保留了合适之义。

items.en: English convenient meant fitting and handy.
items.cn: 英语 convenient 指合适而顺手。

items.en: It now mostly means easy to reach or use.
items.cn: 如今它多指容易到达或使用。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin coming base ven-, and the meaning group names other words for what suits a need.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的来词基 ven-，近义组列出其他表示合于需要的词。

entries.definition: the state of being easy to use
in an easy or suitable way
causing trouble or extra effort
easy to use or close at hand
right for a particular purpose
easy to reach or enter

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a short walk, then move to a good hour and a handle at the right height.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一小段路开始，再到一个好时辰，最后到高度正好的把手。

normal.en: Convenient is the adjective of convenience: it fits your need.
normal.cn: convenient 是 convenience 的形容词：它合你的需要。

normal.en: If the walk is short, the place is convenient.
normal.cn: 路短，地方就方便。

normal.en: A good hour is one that does not fight your clock.
normal.cn: 好的时间，是不跟你的钟表作对的时间。

normal.en: A handle at the right height is convenience in wood.
normal.cn: 高度合适的把手，是木头做成的方便。

normal.en: It fits, so it saves.
normal.cn: 它合得上，所以省力气。

abstract.en: Picture a station door right across the street.
abstract.cn: 想象街对面就是车站的门。

abstract.en: Picture a chair pulled up to a low table.
abstract.cn: 想象一把椅子正好拉到矮桌旁。

abstract.en: Picture a key already in the lock.
abstract.cn: 想象钥匙已经插在锁里。

examples.en: The flat is convenient for the school.
examples.cn: 这套公寓去学校很方便。

examples.en: Is this a convenient time to talk?
examples.cn: 现在方便谈话吗？

examples.en: The tool is light and convenient to use.
examples.cn: 这件工具轻便好用。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 convenient 记成 con（一起）加 ven（来）加 ient：需要的东西恰好在身边来到，就是方便的。

root: 源自拉丁语 convenire（走到一起、相合），由 com-（一起）与 venire（来）构成，加形容词词尾 -ient，指近便、合适与好用。

sensesIntro.en: From a short distance, to a fitting hour, and at last to a tool that meets the hand.
sensesIntro.cn: 从很短的距离，到合适的时辰，最后到朝手迎上来的工具。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a station door directly across the street.
core.cn: 核心意象：街对面就是车站的门。

branches.en: Short distance is the plainest kind of ease.
branches.cn: 短距离是最朴素的省力。

branches.en: A fitting hour removes a different kind of effort.
branches.cn: 合适的时间去掉另一种力气。

branches.en: A well-made tool meets the body halfway.
branches.cn: 做得好用的工具朝身体走了一半。

branches.en: Space and time can both be made to fit.
branches.cn: 空间与时间都能被安排得合身。

branches.en: A good hour and a good handle both say yes.
branches.cn: 好时辰与好把手都在说可以。

intro.en: Convenient is built on Latin com-, together, plus venire, to come.
intro.cn: convenient 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 venire（来）构成。

latinIntro.en: The coming base ven- also appears in convenience, convene and convention.
latinIntro.cn: 来词基 ven- 也出现在 convenience、convene 与 convention 中。

items.meaningCN: 聚会或共同接受的习俗
双方之间有约束力的约定

definition_zh: 惯例；习俗；公约；大会
definition_en: a usual way of doing things, a formal agreement, or a large organized meeting
core_image: 会场里一排排座位，人人按同一套规矩行事
scene: 年会在大厅举行，代表们按名牌落座。The party holds its convention every autumn.
sceneCN: 这里 convention 指「大会」（第 3 个义项：团体或行业的大型正式会议）；句意是这个政党每年秋天举行大会。

senses.title: An accepted habit
senses.definition: a way of behaving that most people in a group accept
senses.definitionCN: 群体中多数人接受的做事方式
senses.example: Shaking hands is a convention, not a law.
senses.exampleCN: 握手是惯例，不是法律。
senses.why: A crowd repeats a habit until it feels like a rule.
senses.whyCN: 一群人反复做一件事，久了就像规定。

senses.title: A formal agreement
senses.definition: a set of rules agreed by many parties
senses.definitionCN: 由多方共同议定的规则集合
senses.example: The treaty follows an older convention.
senses.exampleCN: 该条约沿用了更早的公约。
senses.why: Nations write down what they hope to keep.
senses.whyCN: 国家把希望守住的东西写下来。

senses.title: A large meeting
senses.definition: a big organized meeting of a group or profession
senses.definitionCN: 团体或行业的大型正式会议
senses.example: Thousands came to the yearly convention.
senses.exampleCN: 数千人来参加年度大会。
senses.why: A field of strangers becomes one body for a few days.
senses.whyCN: 一群陌生人在几天里变成一个整体。

intro.en: Convention comes from Latin convenire, to come together, built on com-, together, and venire, to come.
intro.cn: convention 来自拉丁语 convenire（走到一起），由 com-（一起）与 venire（来）构成。

items.en: Venire meant to come or arrive.
items.cn: venire 意为来或到达。

items.en: Convenire meant to meet and to agree with one another.
items.cn: convenire 意为会面，也指彼此取得一致。

items.en: Conventio named a coming together and the agreement made.
items.cn: conventio 指聚到一起以及由此达成的约定。

items.en: French convention kept both the meeting and the custom senses.
items.cn: 法语 convention 同时保留聚会与习俗两层意思。

items.en: English convention meant an agreed custom.
items.cn: 英语 convention 指共同接受的习俗。

items.en: It now also means a large professional gathering.
items.cn: 如今它也指大型的行业聚会。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin coming base ven-, and the meaning group names other words for custom and assembly.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的来词基 ven-，近义组列出其他表示习俗与集会的词。

entries.definition: following the usual accepted way
to call people together for a meeting
the quality of being easy to use
a usual way of behaving in a society
a belief or habit passed down over years
a group of people gathered for a purpose

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a habit a crowd repeats, then move to rules written by many parties and a hall full of strangers.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从人群反复做的习惯开始，再到多方写下的规则，最后到坐满陌生人的大厅。

normal.en: Con- is together and ven is come, so a convention is people coming together.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，ven 是来，convention 就是人们来到一起。

normal.en: When enough people come together, their habit becomes the rule.
normal.cn: 来的人够多，他们的习惯就成了规矩。

normal.en: Nations meet, and the paper they sign is also a convention.
normal.cn: 国家相聚，签下的那张纸也叫公约。

normal.en: A hall of name cards is the meeting sense made visible.
normal.cn: 一屋子名牌，就是聚会义项看得见的样子。

normal.en: Come together, agree, and repeat.
normal.cn: 聚到一起，达成一致，然后反复照做。

abstract.en: Picture a queue forming without anyone giving an order.
abstract.cn: 想象没有人下令，队伍却自己排了起来。

abstract.en: Picture a long table with many pens beside one page.
abstract.cn: 想象一张长桌，许多支笔放在同一页纸旁。

abstract.en: Picture a hall of chairs turned toward one stage.
abstract.cn: 想象大厅里所有椅子都朝向同一个舞台。

examples.en: By convention, the host speaks first.
examples.cn: 按照惯例，主人先发言。

examples.en: The two countries signed a convention on trade.
examples.cn: 两国签署了一项贸易公约。

examples.en: The annual convention opens on Monday.
examples.cn: 年度大会在周一开幕。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 convention 记成 con（一起）加 ven（来）加 tion：大家来到一起、说定一套做法，就是惯例与大会。

root: 源自拉丁语 conventio（聚会与约定），来自 convenire（走到一起），由 con-（一起）与 venire（来）构成，后指习俗、公约与大会。

sensesIntro.en: From a habit a crowd accepts, to rules written by many parties, and at last to a hall of people gathered.
sensesIntro.cn: 从人群接受的习惯，到多方写下的规则，最后到聚满人的大厅。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hall of chairs all turned toward one stage.
core.cn: 核心意象：大厅里所有椅子都朝向同一个舞台。

branches.en: The habit sense grows out of repeated agreement.
branches.cn: 惯例义从反复的一致中长出来。

branches.en: The written sense puts that agreement on paper.
branches.cn: 书面义把这种一致放到纸上。

branches.en: The meeting sense gathers the people themselves.
branches.cn: 大会义把人本身聚起来。

branches.en: A custom and a treaty are both agreed rules.
branches.cn: 习俗与条约都是议定的规则。

branches.en: People who write rules must first come together.
branches.cn: 写规则的人，总要先聚到一起。

intro.en: Convention is built on Latin com-, together, plus venire, to come.
intro.cn: convention 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 venire（来）构成。

latinIntro.en: The coming base ven- also appears in convene, convenient and event.
latinIntro.cn: 来词基 ven- 也出现在 convene、convenient 与 event 中。

items.meaning: a coming together and what is agreed
items.meaningCN: 聚到一起以及所议定的事

items.meaning: a way by which one comes
items.example: The avenue was lined with trees.

items.meaning: to come before and stop something
items.meaningCN: 先一步到来并加以阻止

definition_zh: 传统的；惯例的；常规的
definition_en: following the usual and accepted way of doing things
core_image: 一整排相同的窗子，尺寸和间距都一样
scene: 邻居都装同样的白窗帘，只有她挂了一块彩布。Her house stands out among the conventional ones.
sceneCN: 这里 conventional 指「传统的」（第 1 个义项：按多数人接受的方式行事）；句意是她的房子在那些传统样式的房子中格外显眼。

senses.title: Following custom
senses.definition: acting in the way most people in a society accept
senses.definitionCN: 按社会多数人接受的方式行事
senses.example: They chose a conventional name for the baby.
senses.exampleCN: 他们给宝宝取了个传统的名字。
senses.why: A well-worn path is easy to walk, and easy to notice.
senses.whyCN: 走熟的路好走，也容易被人看见。

senses.title: Usual in method
senses.definition: standard rather than special or new
senses.definitionCN: 采取标准做法而非特殊或新颖的做法
senses.example: The farm uses conventional tools.
senses.exampleCN: 这个农场使用常规工具。
senses.why: Most work is done with what has already been tested.
senses.whyCN: 多数活儿是用已经验过的东西干的。

senses.title: Lacking surprise
senses.definition: plain and not unusual, sometimes in a dull way
senses.definitionCN: 普通、毫不特别，有时显得乏味
senses.example: The ending was too conventional to remember.
senses.exampleCN: 这个结尾太落套，让人记不住。
senses.why: A picture that copies every other picture leaves no mark.
senses.whyCN: 一张照抄其他画的画，不会留下痕迹。

intro.en: Conventional is convention plus the adjective ending -al, from Latin convenire, to come together and agree.
intro.cn: conventional 是 convention 加形容词词尾 -al 构成，源头是拉丁语 convenire（走到一起并取得一致）。

items.en: Convenire meant to meet and to agree.
items.cn: convenire 意为会面并取得一致。

items.en: Conventio named the agreement that followed a meeting.
items.cn: conventio 指会面之后达成的约定。

items.en: French convention carried the sense of an accepted custom.
items.cn: 法语 convention 带有被接受的习俗之义。

items.en: English convention meant a settled habit of a group.
items.cn: 英语 convention 指群体固定的习惯。

items.en: The adjective conventional grew to mean following that habit.
items.cn: 形容词 conventional 逐渐指依照这种习惯。

items.en: It now also hints at a lack of freshness.
items.cn: 如今它也暗示缺少新意。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin coming base ven-, and the meaning group names other words for what follows the usual path.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的来词基 ven-，近义组列出其他表示循常规的词。

entries.definition: an accepted habit or a large meeting
in the accepted way
not following the usual way
following older customs
normal and not special
used as the usual accepted model

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a well-worn path, then move to tested tools and to a picture that copies every other picture.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从走熟的路开始，再到验过的工具，最后到照抄别的画的那幅画。

normal.en: Conventional is the adjective of convention: it follows the accepted way.
normal.cn: conventional 是 convention 的形容词：它照着被接受的方式走。

normal.en: A row of identical windows is convention in stone.
normal.cn: 一排一模一样的窗子，是石头做成的惯例。

normal.en: Conventional wisdom is what everyone says before thinking.
normal.cn: 传统看法是大家还没想就都会说的话。

normal.en: The word can praise safety or blame dullness.
normal.cn: 这个词既能夸稳妥，也能怪乏味。

normal.en: Same path, same steps, same result.
normal.cn: 同一条路，同样的步子，同样的结果。

abstract.en: Picture ten houses with the same white front.
abstract.cn: 想象十座房子有着同样的白色门面。

abstract.en: Picture a row of tools worn smooth by years.
abstract.cn: 想象一排被岁月磨得光滑的工具。

abstract.en: Picture a painting copied line for line from another.
abstract.cn: 想象一幅画逐线照抄了另一幅。

examples.en: She prefers conventional clothes at work.
examples.cn: 上班时她更喜欢传统样式的衣服。

examples.en: The farmers still use conventional methods.
examples.cn: 这些农民仍使用常规方法。

examples.en: His solution was clever but conventional.
examples.cn: 他的办法聪明却很落套。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 conventional 记成 convention（惯例）加 al（形容词尾）：凡事照着惯例走，就是传统的、常规的。

root: 由 convention（惯例、约定）加形容词词尾 -al 构成，源头是拉丁语 convenire（走到一起并取得一致），指循惯例、合常规与缺少新意。

sensesIntro.en: From walking a well-worn path, to using tested tools, and at last to copying a picture already seen.
sensesIntro.cn: 从走一条熟路，到使用验过的工具，最后到照抄一幅已经看过的画。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: ten houses sharing one white front.
core.cn: 核心意象：十座房子共用一个白色门面。

branches.en: The first sense simply follows what people accept.
branches.cn: 第一个义项只是照着人们接受的做法。

branches.en: The second sense chooses the standard tool.
branches.cn: 第二个义项选用标准的工具。

branches.en: The third sense notices what the habit costs.
branches.cn: 第三个义项看出这种习惯付出的代价。

branches.en: Custom and standard method are close neighbours.
branches.cn: 习俗与标准方法是一对近邻。

branches.en: A tested way can also become a dull one.
branches.cn: 验过的路，也可能变成乏味的路。

intro.en: Conventional is convention plus the adjective ending -al.
intro.cn: conventional 由 convention 加形容词词尾 -al 构成。

latinIntro.en: The coming base ven- also appears in convention, convene and prevent.
latinIntro.cn: 来词基 ven- 也出现在 convention、convene 与 prevent 中。
